name: Philipp Fingler
notes: This data from Kay Fingler: Philip Fingler served in WW 1 and had a later career as a plasterer.  He was a member of Lutheran Church of the Redeemer in Winnipeg.  So far as is known, he did not marry.This was later confirmed by info from Audrey Pahl May, 1998. But Audreys date of birth is shown as Dec.19, 1899.Did not change it for now.
